items.detail: New country, new people. It takes time, and that's okay.

items.myth: Call home daily and all is well
items.detail: Calls are good, but friends, clubs and a routine there matter too.

items.fact: Asking for help is a strength
items.detail: Talk to your university's student support services and seniors.

youtube.title: Missing home while studying abroad? Myth vs Fact
youtube.description:
